name: Payloadforge
description: Real payload generation: reverse shells (5 context types), encoder chains (base64/gzip/hex/URI), and stager builders. All output is runnable code.

rev_shell.description: Generate a reverse shell one-liner for a given context.

encode_chain.description: Layer-encode a payload: base64 -> gzip -> base64 -> hex.

parameters.url: URL of the payload to fetch
